title: Medicaid Crossover Payment Amount on Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility Accounts
content:
**Remittance calculation note.** On an Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility account, the Medicaid crossover payment is the crossover price of the line less the Medicaid copayment, never below zero, never more than the line's cost share, and rounded to the cent half up.

- **Crossover price.** The lesser of the line's cost share and the Medicaid monthly rate less what the primary paid, that difference never below zero.
- **Medicaid monthly rate.** The patient's Home Oxygen Therapy class's fee-schedule monthly equipment payment for the stationary system plus its monthly add-on for portable equipment, multiplied by the Medicaid record's allowed-amount percentage of the fee schedule, rounded to the cent half up.
- **Medicaid copayment.** The class's per-line Medicaid copay.

## The line and its figures

The crossover figured is worked from the newest oxygen line the primary adjudicated — the line with the latest adjudication date — using its cost share (the patient responsibility the primary left on the line) and the amount the primary paid, and it settles the coinsurance charge that stems from that line.

## Worked figure (hypothetical class fees and line)

Stationary fee 180.00, portable add-on 30.00; Medicaid record's allowed-amount percentage 82; per-line copay 3.00. Line: cost share 37.50, primary paid 150.00.

| Step | Working | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| Medicaid monthly rate | 180.00 plus 30.00 is 210.00; 82 percent of 210.00 | 172.20 |
| Rate less what the primary paid | 172.20 less 150.00 | 22.20 |
| Crossover price | lesser of 37.50 and 22.20 | 22.20 |
| Less the copayment | 22.20 less 3.00 | **19.20** |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical; same rate 172.20, copay 3.00)

| Primary paid | Cost share | Price | Payment |
|---|---|---|---|
| 175.00 | 37.50 | 0.00 (difference below zero) | 0.00 |
| 150.00 | 4.00 | 4.00 (the cost share is the lesser) | 1.00 |
| 100.00 | 37.50 | 37.50 | 34.50 |
